warnings: Exploratory follow-up. Exact-compatible predictions and measurements are reused with source hashes. Historical and new explanation prompt cohorts remain identifiable; legacy pilot and notebook predictions are separate.
limitations: Scores are normalized answer likelihoods, not validated customer probabilities.
Edited scenarios have no observed outcome. Sensitivity does not establish customer motives.
Valid citations do not validate explanation prose; manual grounding review is separate.
Group-cluster intervals are exploratory with few groups. Subgroups are not confirmatory.
Candidate identities remain visible in retention tests; priors can preserve predictions.

development.interpretation: Weak own-price monotonicity: price increase does not raise the affected candidate score. Sensitivity diagnostic only; ties count as weak agreement. Not a claim about explanations or customers.
